description: A secretary for your Codex tasks: concise progress briefings, direction and ROI discussions, and bounded delegation that keeps the manager conversation available.

defaultPrompt: Orbit, brief me on changes across my Codex tasks.
Orbit, help me choose which tasks to coordinate.
Orbit, coordinate this selected task within the scope I approve.
interface.longDescription: Get the essentials across your Codex tasks in one conversation: progress, meaningful blockers and decisions for you. Discuss priorities and delegate agreed work to authorized tasks or agents. Orbit briefly reports the handoff and returns to you; detailed evidence is available when requested. Task coordination depends on your Codex environment. Unattended recurring management and automatic cancellation of already delivered instructions are not included.

name: orbit-secretary
